items.title: 80th Independence Day Celebrations
items.whyInNews: The 80th Independence Day of India was celebrated on August 15, 2026, with President Droupadi Murmu addressing the nation. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also greeted the people on this occasion.
items.summary: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the nation on the eve of the 80th Independence Day, highlighting the country's progress and urging citizens to work towards a developed India. Prime Minister Narendra Modi greeted the people on this occasion, emphasizing the nation's resolve to become a developed country. The celebrations were marked by various events and ceremonies across the country, including the hoisting of the national flag and the presentation of awards to brave soldiers.

items.title: Government Scraps 12-Minute Ad Time Limit for TV Channels
items.whyInNews: The government has removed the 12-minute per hour limit on advertising time for television channels, effective immediately.
items.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has scrapped the 12-minute per hour limit on advertising time for television channels, allowing them to broadcast more ads. This move is expected to benefit the television industry, which has been facing financial difficulties due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The decision was made to provide relief to the industry and promote economic growth.

items.title: Ken-Betwa River Linking Project: Current Status
